passage: This year's conference focused on how warming oceans affect marine life. The marine biologist, who had studied coral reefs for two ______ was invited to speak at the international conference.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: "who had studied coral reefs for two decades" is extra information that interrupts the main sentence.
It opens with a comma after "biologist", so it must close with a comma.
A dash or semicolon wouldn't match the opening comma; no punctuation leaves it unclosed.
Check: "The marine biologist was invited to speak…" works on its own.
key: Interrupting phrases need matching punctuation on both sides: comma…comma or dash…dash.
